s00-01-story-d92d42.wav.text: The walls of Jericho were so high, no army could climb them.

s00-02-story-c7bed1.wav.text: So how did Israel take the city?

s00-05-pivot-b03cc3.wav.text: Most people think this is a war story.

s01-01-story-5d9210.wav.text: Forty years after the Red Sea, Israel stood on the edge of the land God had promised them.

s01-02-story-67c220.wav.text: Moses had died. Their new leader was Joshua.

s01-03-story-643024.wav.text: And the first thing in their way was Jericho.

s01-04-story-55ada6.wav.text: A city of thick, high walls, on the road into the land.

s02-01-story-7e825f.wav.text: Joshua sent two men to look at the city.

s02-02-story-c9f168.wav.text: They hid in the house of a woman named Rahab, built right into the city wall.

s02-03-story-eddb05.wav.text: When the king's soldiers came looking, she hid them on her roof under stalks of flax.

s02-05-story-e211aa.wav.text: Everyone in Jericho had heard what God did at the Red Sea.

s02-07-grave-f0dc38.wav.text: for the LORD your God, he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.

s03-01-story-25890b.wav.text: The spies made her a promise.

s03-02-story-befc60.wav.text: When Israel came, she must tie a red cord in her window.

s03-03-story-22bfa6.wav.text: And everyone inside her house would be safe.

s03-04-talk-1cfb33.wav.text: A red mark, and a family saved.

s03-05-story-6e7072.wav.text: It's the Passover all over again.

s04-01-story-66d98b.wav.text: Then, just like at the Red Sea, God stopped the river, and they crossed on dry ground.

s04-02-story-4310f7.wav.text: Joshua looked up at the walls of Jericho. And God spoke.

s04-03-grave-1ba29a.wav.text: See, I have given Jericho into your hand.

s04-04-pivot-c031cf.wav.text: Then God gave Joshua the strangest battle plan in the Bible.

s04-05-talk-dc4afc.wav.text: March round the city once a day, for six days.

s04-06-story-ce520d.wav.text: Seven priests with trumpets in front. No shouting.

s05-01-story-0d8388.wav.text: Day after day, they walked round the city. Silent.

s05-03-talk-a1623f.wav.text: Imagine how that looked from the walls.

s05-04-story-f15ef6.wav.text: No ladders. No battering rams. Not a single sword raised.

s05-05-talk-88fe1e.wav.text: Just people, walking, because God told them to.

s06-01-story-0a4bf1.wav.text: On the seventh day, they walked round the city seven times.

s06-02-story-35c61c.wav.text: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua said, "Shout!

s06-03-story-3227fb.wav.text: For the LORD has given you the city."

s06-04-grave-ff4b2f.wav.text: As soon as the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted a great shout,

s06-05-grave-977fab.wav.text: and the wall fell down flat.

s07-01-pivot-ff803c.wav.text: But one house was still standing.

s07-02-story-cbfac7.wav.text: The one with the red cord.

s07-03-story-de2afc.wav.text: Rahab and her whole family were brought out safe.

s07-04-story-a96e2c.wav.text: And she lived among God's people from then on.

s07-05-talk-8d4845.wav.text: Centuries later, the book of Hebrews looked back on that day.

s07-06-grave-d4b616.wav.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

s08-01-talk-0f52e2.wav.text: The walls didn't fall because Israel was strong.

s08-02-story-8766f8.wav.text: They fell because Israel trusted God, even when his plan looked foolish.

s08-03-talk-8abbb5.wav.text: And Rahab, an outsider, trusted him too.

s08-04-story-33d8c3.wav.text: Matthew's Gospel names her in the family line of Jesus.

s08-05-pivot-667f3a.wav.text: God's rescue was always bigger than one nation.
